definition: A supplemental schedule for individual taxpayers to calculate and report this document, including medical expenses, state and local taxes, mortgage interest, charitable contributions, and casualty losses, as an alternative to claiming the standard deduction.

includes.text: Contains line items for medical and dental expenses, state and local taxes, home mortgage interest, charitable gifts, and casualty losses
Provides detailed worksheets and tables for calculating specific deduction categories
includes.quote: State and Local General Sales Tax Deduction Worksheet

includes.text: Includes optional sales tax tables organized by state and locality

excludes.text: Does not report business income and expenses from self-employment or sole proprietorship
Does not allocate income or losses among multiple partners or beneficiaries

discriminators.text: Reports itemized personal deductions for individual taxpayers; a sibling reports rental, royalty, and partnership income allocated to individual partners
Reports itemized personal deductions; a sibling reports profit or loss from farming operations
Reports itemized personal deductions; a sibling reports business income and expenses from self-employment or sole proprietorship
